sn14.1:1.1: tatra vagguddānaṃ: buddho āhāro dasabalo kaḷāro gahapati pañcamo, dukkhavaggo mahāvaggo aṭṭhamo samaṇabrāhmaṇo, navamo’ntarapeyyālo dasamo’bhisamayo bhaveti. 2. dhātusaṃyuttaṃ 1. nānattavaggo 2. 1. 1. dhātunānattasuttaṃ sāvatthiyaṃ–
sn14.1:1.3: taṃ suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasi karotha bhāsissāmīti.
sn14.1:1.4: evaṃ bhanteti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ,
sn14.1:2.2: cakkhudhātu rūpadhātu cakkhuviññāṇadhātu, sotadhātu saddadhātu sotaviññāṇadhātu, ghānadhātu gandhadhātu ghānaviññāṇadhātu, jivhādhātu rasadhātu jivhāviññāṇadhātu, kāyadhātu phoṭṭhabbadhātu kāyaviññāṇadhātu, manodhātu dhammadhātu manoviññāṇadhātu.
